english.note: Use this for doing something quietly and without fuss, often with an implication that others are not meant to notice.

examples.english: I unobtrusively tidied up the room so the guests would get a surprise when they arrived.
examples.traditional: 我唔聲唔聲咁執好間房，等客人嚟到先畀佢哋驚喜。
